mine.title: My runners
mine.sub: Your computers and servers that build your projects. Builds on them don't use installation quotas.

disabled.title: The administrator turned personal runners off.
disabled.body: Builds use shared runners. You can't connect a new runner right now.

how.title: How it works
how.own: Your own builds of your projects go to your runner when it's online.
how.coauthors: Co-authors' builds go to your runner only if you turned that on in the project settings.
how.fallback: If the runner is offline or doesn't take a build within {{seconds}} s, the build goes to shared runners.
how.trust: The runner gets a copy of the project for the build. Connect only your own machines.

empty.title: No runners yet
empty.body: Connect the Studio on your computer or start a runner on a server from the console: your projects will build on it.

mine.caption: My runners

stateHint.stale: If it doesn't respond, builds go to shared runners.
stateHint.pausedByAdmin: Paused by an administrator: only they can resume it.

mine.outdatedHint: The server is newer ({{version}}): update the runner.

rename.title: Rename runner
rename.label: Name
rename.hint: Co-authors see it when their builds run on your runners.

revoke.title: Revoke runner
revoke.body: The runner stops getting builds right away. This can't be undone: to build on that machine again, connect it again.

rotate.confirmBody: The old token stops working right away. You'll need to restart the runner with the new one.
rotate.title: New token for runner "{{name}}"
rotate.lead: The old token no longer works. Restart the runner with the new one.
rotate.label: Runner token

reconnect.title: Reconnect "{{name}}"
reconnect.body: This is the Studio on a computer: it keeps its token itself. In the Studio open Settings, Cloud builds, click "Disconnect from server" and connect again with a code.

connectDialog.title: Connect a runner
connectDialog.lead: A runner builds your projects on your machine. Choose what to connect.

studio.step1: Open the Studio, then Settings, Cloud builds.
studio.step2: Turn the switch on and click "Connect".
studio.step3: Enter the code the Studio shows and confirm the connection.
studio.codeInvalid: The code is eight letters and digits, for example BCDF-2345.

server.lead: Create a one-time token and start the runner with a command on your server. The token is shown once.
server.label: Label
server.labelHint: To tell the token apart in the list, for example "Home server".
server.secretHint: After registering, the runner gets its own permanent token.
server.dockerHint: The data directory is mounted at the same path inside and outside the container.
server.aiHint: To use your own model through the runner, set HSE_RUNNER__AI_ENDPOINTS, for example [{"name":"ollama","url":"http://localhost:11434/v1"}].
server.waiting: Waiting for the runner to connect…

tokens.title: Unused tokens
tokens.lead: Tokens no runner has connected with yet.
tokens.revokeBody: No runner will be able to connect with "{{label}}".

failure.unknown: Couldn't complete the action. Try again.
failure.network: The server is unreachable. Check your connection.

pair.enterTitle: Enter the code from the Studio
pair.enterLead: The Studio shows an eight-character code after you click "Connect" in Cloud builds.
pair.question: Connect "{{name}}" as your runner?
pair.warning: Confirm only if you've just clicked "Connect" in your own Studio. The runner will get copies of your projects when building and will be able to answer on behalf of your models.

approved.title: Done
approved.body: Go back to the Studio: it will connect by itself.

expired.title: The code has expired
expired.body: Start connecting from the Studio again.

used.title: The code has already been used
used.body: If it's your device, it's already in your runners.

disabled.title: Personal runners are off
disabled.body: The administrator turned personal runners off on this installation: the device can't be connected.

limit.title: Runner limit reached
limit.body: Revoke a runner or an unused token you don't need, then confirm the code again.

remote.title: Cloud builds
remote.sub: This machine can build your cloud projects from the server with its own Docker. Your local projects are not affected.
remote.toggle: Build my cloud projects on this machine
remote.toggleHint: The Studio will connect to your account on the server and build your cloud projects with local Docker. Your local projects are not affected.

state.pairing: Waiting for the code to be confirmed
state.revoked: The runner was revoked on the server. Connect again.
state.disabled: The server administrator turned personal runners off.

remote.serverUrlHint: The one you open in the browser. https is required; http only works for localhost.
remote.serverUrlInvalid: An https address is required, http only for localhost.
remote.name: This machine's name
remote.nameHint: The runner's name in "My runners". A name set on the website wins.
remote.tokenHint: Create it on the website: "My runners", "Connect a runner", "Server or console".

code.title: Confirm the code on the website
code.lead: Open the confirmation page in the browser where you're signed in and check that the code matches.
code.expired: The code has expired: start connecting again.

checks.docker: Docker is unavailable: LaTeX cloud builds go to shared runners.
checks.image: The TeX image isn't installed: LaTeX builds go to shared runners.

remote.concurrencyHint: How many cloud builds to take at the same time.
remote.yieldHint: While a local build runs, cloud builds aren't taken. Model requests through the runner keep working.

models.title: Models for the cloud
models.lead: Local models the server can reach through this machine. The address stays here; the server only knows the name.
models.empty: No local Ollama or OpenAI-compatible providers in your network.
models.name: Name for the server
models.nameInvalid: Latin letters, digits, dash and underscore, up to 32 characters.

remote.unpairTitle: Disconnect the Studio from the server?
remote.unpairBody: The runner will be revoked and cloud builds will stop running on this machine. You can connect it again any time.
remote.unpaired: The Studio is disconnected from the server
